item.title: UP Horror: Man shoots wife’s alleged lover in Meerut market, posts ‘revenge’ video before arrest
item.description: A shocking daylight murder in Meerut’s Ramraj town has stunned locals after a man allegedly shot his wife’s lover in a crowded market and later posted a video online claiming revenge. Police arrested the accused hours after the incident.

item.title: India vs Zimbabwe T20 World Cup: IND Wins By 72 Runs, Stay Alive In Semi-Final Race
item.description: India delivered a batting masterclass in the T20 World Cup 2026 Super 8 clash, piling up a record 256 against Zimbabwe in Chennai. Abhishek Sharma and Hardik Pandya starred as Zimbabwe now face a daunting 257-run target.

item.title: Rinku Singh’s father passes away amid T20 World Cup 2026; Cricketing fraternity mourns
item.description: Indian cricketer Rinku Singh suffered a personal tragedy during the T20 World Cup 2026 as his father, Khan Chand Singh, passed away after battling stage-4 liver cancer. He was admitted to Yatharth Hospital in critical condition.

item.title: Markets Open Weak: Sensex slides over 450 points, Nifty slips below 25,350
item.description: Indian equity benchmarks fell sharply on Friday, with the Sensex dropping over 450 points below 82,000 and the Nifty slipping under 25,350. Selling pressure weighed on heavyweights including Bharti Airtel and IndiGo, while IT stocks showed mild recovery.

item.title: Gold climbs on MCX after US-Iran talks end without deal; Check price here
item.description: Gold prices rose on the Multi Commodity Exchange of India (MCX) after US-Iran talks ended without a deal, heightening geopolitical uncertainty. April gold futures gained nearly ₹500, while silver surged almost 3% in early trade.

item.title: Court Acquits Arvind Kejriwal and Manish Sisodia in Delhi Excise Policy Case; Details here
item.description: In a major relief for Arvind Kejriwal and Manish Sisodia, the Rouse Avenue Court acquitted both leaders in the Delhi excise policy case, stating there was no evidence of conspiracy.

item.title: ‘I Am Not Corrupt’: Kejriwal turns emotional after acquittal in Delhi excise policy case
item.description: The Rouse Avenue Court acquitted Arvind Kejriwal and Manish Sisodia in the Delhi excise policy case, bringing major relief to the AAP leadership. Kejriwal turned emotional, asserting his honesty and faith in the legal system, while Sunita Kejriwal said truth always prevails.
